eBirdPolicy: eBird sightings/Status-and-Trends are reference-only; NO commercial eBird API/data ingestion, copies of maps, or public raw-data republication without prior explicit permission. Macaulay media require separate rights/license, not blanket free download.
sourceHierarchy: Vogelbescherming + actual ANWB species passages for first morphology references; Sovon for NL status; eBird additional detection/distribution/season evidence; originals and licenses for each audio. Don't infer birds are absent from unreported areas.
reviewGateBeforeOtherSpecies: Complete the 140 cohort across media/provenance/voice-type/distribution fields before expanding photo/audio work to outside-140 species. Individual exceptions allowed only with recorded unavailable-rights/biology evidence and owner's review; no fake media.
